LESSON: SIGNIFICANCE OF TAWHID

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.1: Significance of Tawhid
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Significance of Tawhid, part of Pillars of Iman in Grade 7 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: howing belief in Tawhid in pairs or groups and make notes, • role-play ways of showing belief in Tawhid. 1. Why do Muslims believe in Tawhid?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. research on the significance of Tawhid in the life of a Muslim and make class presentations,

2. discuss the significance of Tawhid and make notes,

3. search online /from available books on the ways of showing belief in Tawhid and share in class,

4. discuss ways of showing belief in Tawhid in pairs or groups and make notes,

5. role-play ways of showing belief in Tawhid. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. research on the significance of Tawhid in the life of a Muslim and make class presentations,
2. discuss the significance of Tawhid and make notes,
3. search online /from available books on the ways of showing belief in Tawhid and share in class,
4. discuss ways of showing belief in Tawhid in pairs or groups and make notes,
5. role-play ways of showing belief in Tawhid. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Significance of Tawhid together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: skills of listening, speaking, writing and teamwork as learners listen, appreciate and

respect the opinion of others when discussing the significance of Tawhid in groups and make notes.

• Critical thinking and Problem-solving since the learners acquire the skill of reflection when researching the ways of showing

belief in Tawhid.

• Digital Literacy: skills of interacting with digital devices when searching and downloading materials on the ways of showing

belief in Tawhid.

Values:
Unity: the learners cooperate as they discuss in groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

Citizenship: Social cohesion as learners discuss in groups the significance of Tawhid.
